notes.title: Update the Credit Roll
notes.notes:
Use real-time rendering content instead of video files.

We're also porting the game to the mobile platform. Stay tuned :)

notes.title: Basic Controller Support Added and Translation Updated
notes.notes:
Two years have passed and it's the season of snow again.

This time we have added basic 'Controller Support' to the game, so you can play through Xbox controller or SteamDeck.

We have also improved the English translation of the game, fixing many grammar and translation problems.

We hope everyone stays away from epidemics and enjoys the warmth of the holiday season!

notes.title: The soundtrack collection is now released!
notes.notes:
Thanks to the support of all players, the OST of "Flowers in the Snow" is now released.
The music collection contains one theme song and six original music tracks in MP3 and WAV formats.

In the music, can you recall the story of Ling and Claudia, as well as the fragrance of lily of the hollow?
Perhaps in the distant land of snow, the swordsman in red is also listening quietly.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1558540/_/

notes.title: Flower in the Snow - Resurrection Released!
notes.notes:
Thank you for the waiting. We finally released Flower in the Snow - Resurrection on Steam.

The version with Achievements System just got published. If you finished the game before you could try to use 'Ctrl' and fastforwrd the content to get Achievements. We're very sorry for the inconvenience caused.

If you're on Win10 and cannot launch the game, try to use Win7 compatibility mode for the exe file.

Let us know if there are issues blocking from accessing the game!

2020 will pass, we hope every one enjoy the New Year!
